title: The God Who Records Every People

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Egypt was the father of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites, Pathrusites, Kasluhites (from whom the Philistines came) and Caphtorites. - Gen 10:13-14 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Another string of unfamiliar names, peoples descended from Egypt, including a note that the Philistines came from this line - a people who would trouble Israel for generations. It would be easy to skim past such a verse. But pause and consider: God took the trouble to record these peoples in His Word. Every nation, even the obscure ones, even future adversaries, is known to God and noted by Him.

This tells us how thoroughly God knows the peoples of the earth. He is not vaguely aware of humanity in the mass; He knows the specific clans, tribes, and nations, each by name. Not one people group escapes His notice. The God of the Bible is a God of detail, who keeps account of every branch of the human family.

If God so carefully records whole nations, we can be sure He knows and remembers every individual too. You are never lost in the crowd of humanity. The God who names the Naphtuhites and the Caphtorites certainly knows you - your name, your story, your place in His world.

There is deep comfort here for anyone who feels overlooked or forgotten. The God who keeps such careful record of all peoples has your name written down too. Jesus assured His followers that even "the very hairs of your head are all numbered" (Matt 10:30). Nothing about you is too small or too obscure for God's attention. The God who records every people remembers you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you ever feel overlooked or lost in the crowd?
- How does God's careful knowledge of every people assure you of His care for you?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You know and record every people on earth, down to the smallest and most obscure. Thank You that I am never lost in the crowd to You. You know my name and my story, and You care for me.
